title: Watch birds at s'Albufera des Grau
description: Menorca's only nature park and the heart of the Biosphere Reserve: a lagoon, three short, level trails and wooden hides from which you can see herons, cormorants, grebes and birds of prey. Autumn and spring migration is when there are most birds and fewest people. The trails are free and start at the visitor centre.
whenLabel: All year · migration peaks in autumn and spring
